description: Verify that a single passive socket accepts SYNs from 3 distinct remote source ports and replies SYN,ACK on each (RFC 793 §3.4)
approach:
[Objective]
One LISTENing socket can host multiple simultaneous connections, distinguished by the remote 4-tuple. Each new SYN with a different source port spawns a separate connection.

[Scenario — chronological]
1. DUT in LISTEN on port P.
2. Tester → DUT: SYN from src_port S1, S2, S3 (sequentially or interleaved).
3. Observation: DUT → Tester: SYN,ACK for each leg.

[Pass condition]
DUT emits SYN,ACK for all 3 legs.

[Fail condition]
• Fail_timeout_leg<n> — no DUT SYN,ACK for the corresponding leg

verdicts.Pass: DUT acked SYN from 3 distinct source ports — normal
